name: CRUX website

source.readFrom: Extracted from the Desktop design frame.

character: DARK-MODE premium tech / software agency. Deep navy-black throughout, electric-blue accent, white text, glassy dark cards with subtle borders and radial-glow lighting. Reads high-end, technical, expensive. Best for software, dev shops, B2B SaaS, fintech, or any brand that wants a 'serious engineering' feel.

scale.note: Hero, part of the headline in blue.

typography.notes: Single geometric sans (DM Sans). One word of the hero headline is set in the blue accent.

color.notes: DARK theme: near-black navy bg, white/soft-white text, one electric-blue accent for CTAs, filled stat cards, links and headline highlights. Cards are dark with a faint light border + inner glow. REUSE the dark-glass structure; put the lead's brand colour in the blue slot (only if the lead suits dark mode — otherwise use a light system).

spacing.notes: Very generous dark sections (~96–120px), roomy cards, ~1200px content column with a wide dark gutter.

button.notes: Blue primary + outline secondary side by side in the hero.

card.shape: Dark glass: dark fill, 1px translucent-white border, rounded, subtle inner glow.
types: service card (blue icon + title + desc + link)

order.layout: Dark bar: logo left, nav center, blue 'Get Started' pill right.
Full dark hero with a blue radial glow; large centered headline (one word blue) + subhead + two buttons (blue + outline); two feature cards below (one with a product/tech image).
Greyscale tech-brand logo row on dark (Google, AWS, Stripe…).
Two columns: left heading + paragraph, right a 2×2 grid of filled-blue stat cards (9+, 500+, 45+, 25).
Heading + a 2×3 grid of dark service cards (blue icon → title → description → link).
Left a team photo in a rounded frame with a floating stat badge; right heading + 3 icon bullet points.
Centered heading + one large filled-blue quote card (quote → avatar → name), carousel dots.
Heading + a row of 3 team photo cards (photo → name → role).
Centered heading + blue button on dark.

reusableArchetypes: dark hero with radial glow + blue-highlighted headline
craftNotes: Dark glass cards (faint white border + inner glow) instead of solid boxes.
One electric-blue accent does all the highlighting; everything else is monochrome dark.
Radial glows behind the hero and section headers add depth.

reuse: Use for software / SaaS / B2B / fintech leads that suit a dark, premium look. Take the dark-glass card system, blue-accent discipline, stat-grid + expertise-grid + single-testimonial archetypes. Swap blue for the lead's brand colour. Only pick this system when dark mode fits the brand.
